name: buyer.search.mine
title: Profile: buyer.search.mine
description: Canonical buyer query profile for the current actor's own listings.
text:
# buyer.search.mine

TL;DR:
- Use this profile for 'my listings' in buyer context.
- The canonical filter is filter.my = true.

This profile narrows search to listings that belong to the current authenticated actor.
whenToUse: The user asks for their own listings in buyer context.
The workflow is actor-relative ownership inspection.
recommended: Use buyer.listingCollection for browsing multiple own listings.
Use buyer.listingFetch only when one specific own listing needs focused inspection.
avoid: Do not substitute filter.withOwn for this profile.
Do not use this profile without authenticated buyer context.
exampleInterpretation: Returned items belong to the current actor.
listing.my should be true for matching results.
